role: OvernightChartsView convenience initialisers (with and without inter-chart content) and the OvernightStats value model with HK-HR backfill helpers.
types: OvernightChartsView: extension — init with @ViewBuilder interChartContent; constrained extension (InterChartContent == EmptyView) init without it, the entry point the #Preview and OvernightSnapshotTests use
OvernightStats: struct — computed overnight HR/HRV/sleep/window stats, chart viewport, and peakSearchBandMs (the 30–70% band the peak search used, for the chart markers; nil without known sleep)
toplevel: OvernightStats.empty sets every numeric to 0 / empty, sleepEfficiency and peakSearchBandMs nil, but deepSleepMinutes and awakeningsCount to 0.

units.does: Assigns session, result, HK sleep, onReanalyzeAt, manual mode/result, hideSleepRow and evaluates the interChartContent builder.
Same assignments with interChartContent = EmptyView() for callers without inter-chart content.
units.entry: Called by the #Preview in OvernightHRVChartCanvas.swift:582 and OvernightSnapshotTests.

units.does: Returns a copy with HK HR samples and new chart bounds, backfilling min/max/nadir/avg (and nadir clock time) from HK when the RR-derived summary is zero; every other field, peakSearchBandMs included, is carried over.
If any of min/max/nadir is 0 and HK samples exist, derives min=max sample extremes, nadir=min, nadirTimeMs of the min sample, avg=trimmed mean; else returns the existing values.

branches.cond: no backfill needed (all non-zero, or hr empty)

units.does: Keeps nadirTimeFormatted unless it is empty and the nadir is positive, then formats sessionStart + nadirTimeMs with the clock formatter.
Plain mean for < 10 samples (0 for empty), else mean of the 5th–95th percentile slice.
